title: Swachhata Se Sabhyata Session Held At Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
subtitle: Swachhata Campaign 6.0 Focusses on Cleanliness, Inner Values and Jan Bhagidari
body_text:
The Department of Social Justice and Empowerment under Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, organized a special awareness session titled Swachhata se Sabhyata in collaboration with the Brahma Kumaris at the Ministry, in the National Capital here.
The session was held as part of the Swachhata Campaign 6.0 observed across the country with its focus on Jan Bhagidari.
Addressing officers and staff, Sister Vidarthi of the Brahma Kumaris spoke about the connection between inner values and the cleanliness of one’s surroundings.
Citing the principle Jaisi Awastha, Waisi Vyavastha, she explained that a person’s state of mind shapes the order they create around them, whether at home, in the workplace or in the wider community.
Referring to the maxim Cleanliness is next to Godliness , Sister Vidarthi encouraged participants to regard cleanliness as a practice rooted in self-respect and inner purity, alongside their civic responsibilities.
She emphasised respect for nature, social sensitivity and simple living, and observed that lasting physical cleanliness is supported by cleanliness in thought, speech and conduct.
Sister Vidarthi also highlighted recycling as a practical habit that promotes responsible use of resources and contributes to better waste management.
At the conclusion of the session, officers and staff of the Department reaffirmed their commitment to maintaining cleanliness in their workplaces and communities throughout the year.
